The smallest missing bridge is correlation between that decision and one supported real claimed-write payload, which the existing pre-write adapter already identifies and receipts.
bounded_shape: Consume an exact immutable scenario path supplied explicitly for the observation run.
Evaluate the same current session, claim, worktree, branch, and target payload as the ordinary pre-write adapter.
Append a correlated would_allow or would_deny observation after the ordinary claim decision.
Keep the ordinary claim result and process exit code unchanged.
next_integration_seam.falsification_condition: If one exact scenario cannot be correlated to the current claimed-write receipt without ambiguous or stale session selection, or if observe mode changes ordinary admission, stop the adapter experiment and make durable claim/session lease binding the prerequisite seam.
explicitly_deferred: pre-write projection refresh for outcome data
